title: TrinityowensrecreationRP
description: some changed textures that, I thought would suit me and if you like them, feel free to download. all diamond things are now pink, hearts and heardcore hearts are purple and I made the apple a drapple apple, aka a green apple.
body:
please don't claim as your own.
this is based on what I like and what I wanted to do so if you don't like it don't take my reasource pack and change it.

I changed some textures keeping a pink and purple theme as their my top two favourite colours while also changing the apple to a green apple aka a drapple apple (iykyk).

this reasourcepack adds new textures to, just a few things like all diamond tools, weapons and items, except diamond ore, the apple is now green, the heartss are now purple, and pink and purple concrete is now pastel.
